_README: Model presets for local image generation (server/imagegen.js).
Copy this to presets.json INSIDE the folder PLUMI_IMAGE_DIR points at, then restart.
You only need it to add or change a model — with no presets.json the built-in
Z-Image Turbo preset below is used as-is.
'args' is passed VERBATIM to whichever binary runs — the resident sd-server or
the one-shot sd-cli — before the flags the server owns (-p, -n, -W, -H, --steps,
--cfg-scale, -s, -o). That is deliberate: the flag naming the text encoder differs
by model family (--llm for the Qwen-family encoders, --t5xxl and --clip_l for the
Stable Diffusion lineage), so keeping it opaque is exactly what lets a second
model be added without touching any code.
Speed lives here too, not in the code. On one 8 GB card this preset draws a
1216x832 picture in 17s on a loaded engine; swapping --diffusion-fa for
--sage-attn and dropping --vae-tiling measured 15s with no visible difference.
It is not the default because both depend on the build and the card, and a flag
the binary does not recognise costs you the model rather than two seconds.
Relative paths resolve inside PLUMI_IMAGE_DIR and may not escape it.
'requires' is what the capability check looks for: a preset with a missing file
is dropped with a reason at startup rather than failing at the moment someone
asks for a picture.
'sizes' must be positive multiples of 16. The server picks one from the shape
the model asked for; the model never sends pixel dimensions.

z-image-turbo.label: Z-Image Turbo
z-image-turbo.hint: Fast (8 steps). Good for most illustrations and photographs.
